name: hyperdriveQueries
description: Query count and query latency for a Hyperdrive config

postBody.query: query($accountTag:string!,$configId:string,$start:Time!,$end:Time!){viewer{accounts(filter:{accountTag:$accountTag}){hyperdriveQueriesAdaptiveGroups(limit:10000,filter:{configId:$configId,datetime_geq:$start,datetime_leq:$end},orderBy:[{{ (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 5400 ? 'datetimeMinute' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 46800 ? 'datetimeFiveMinutes' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 90000 ? 'datetimeFifteenMinutes' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 2764800 ? 'datetimeHour' : 'date' }}_ASC]){count avg{queryLatency} dimensions{date: {{ (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 5400 ? 'datetimeMinute' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 46800 ? 'datetimeFiveMinutes' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 90000 ? 'datetimeFifteenMinutes' : (timeframe.unixEnd - timeframe.unixStart) <= 2764800 ? 'datetimeHour' : 'date' }}}}}}}
